prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1081; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Front bumper cover cracked across the center with the lower valance torn free, and the hood leading edge bent upward where it met the impact. The radiator support shows a shallow buckle, and the left headlamp assembly is cracked at its mounting tab. Damage pattern is consistent with the reported frontal contact at low speed, and no prior damage to the vehicle is known from the records reviewed. Proposed plan is to replace the bumper cover, valance, hood and headlamp, and to straighten the radiator support before refinishing. Labor hours submitted fit the scope of this damage. Two similar charges posted to this file on the same day are currently under review and will be confirmed before payment is released.
